findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document with `self.repo.get(doc_id)` and skips the `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)` ownership check, so any authenticated user can rename another user's document (IDOR) and can also tell which document ids exist.

judge.reason: Same defect: rename uses repo.get without the _owned ownership check, allowing renaming others' documents and id enumeration.

findings.label: hit
